items.title: Meta Ads: $343.51 spend, 31 leads, $11.08 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Catch-up run after a 15-day gap (last success 2026-08-14); window widened to the max 7 days (2026-08-22 to 2026-08-28, capped per policy) covering only the tail of the gap. Meta spent $343.51 across the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 31 leads at $11.08 CPL — below the preceding 7-day baseline of ~$15.47 CPL ($355.90 / 23 leads, 2026-08-15 to 2026-08-21). Account is ACTIVE, no ads flagged, no campaign anomalies this window.

needs_attention: Catch-up run: last successful meta-ads ingest was 2026-08-14 (~15 days ago, beyond the 7-day lookback this agent checks). Per policy the primary window was widened to the maximum of 7 days (2026-08-22 to 2026-08-28) rather than the full gap. 2026-08-15 through 2026-08-21 was pulled ONLY as a baseline for CPL comparison, not reported in items/metrics here — that stretch has no meta-ads ingest coverage and Albert should be aware spend/leads for 2026-08-15–2026-08-21 were never ingested day-by-day.

Because the widened window is a 7-day campaign-level aggregate (not day-bucketed), a single quiet day within 2026-08-22–2026-08-28 would not surface as its own anomaly — only window-level totals were checked.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 31, matching the counted leads exactly). Same pattern flagged on 2026-08-14; no discrepancy today, but the script's lead-action set likely needs extending rather than hand-patching here.
